verdict.rationale: Braintrust's 'Loop' agent lets users query logs and build scorers/datasets/dashboards via natural language, and MCP integration extends this to editors like Cursor/Claude Code, supporting agentic/NL operation for observability tasks. However, core workflows like eval setup, playgrounds, and CLI usage still rely on code/config rather than pure natural-language commands, so NL control covers only part of the product surface.
